findings.evidence: 'd.name == n or d.name.startswith(n + '-')' restricts candidate session directories before recorded message cwd values are examined. With --project /home/user/api, a session launched under /home/user/workspace and later recording cwd /home/user/api is excluded entirely, silently omitting approved activity despite the script's support for project changes within sessions.
findings.fix: Make scoped discovery account for sessions launched outside the requested project that later enter it, using a consented metadata index or explicitly approved broader history scan. Preserve per-message in_scope filtering. Add a regression test with a session stored under -home-user-workspace, an in-window message recording cwd /home/user/api, and --project /home/user/api; verify that the matching activity is included.
